The weak scream till hoarse without anyone who cares.

The strong soft whisper with words deeply rooted in the hearts of the people.

A burning skill tree, each leaf carrying a different spirit pattern. With his sect destroyed, Lu Ye, who was reduced to a mining s*ave, became a cultivator. He soon started to stir up the land of Kyushu.

As expected from Martial Peak author, the writing style also similar. One thing is I feel like this time the author doesn't waste much time to write an exquisitive explanation.

Now let's talk about the character.

... more>>
Spoiler

Lu Ye our MC, you can said that he is Yang Kai incarnation. With some exceptions like Lu Ye is more serious and indifferent person. While Yang Kai is more free spirited and well... shameless person. Both have thick mu*derous aura but Lu Ye can be said more extreme as it is shown in the story that he didn't even blink when slaying the fairer s*x. He will kill his enemies no matter the gender.

Although he is scary guy to his enemies, he is a sensible and responsible also caring to his friends and allies. He have many similarities with YK in this aspect.

If the romance or harem exist here, I just hope it won't be a useless decoration and plot device like Martial Peak. Until now the character close to LY is developing nicely including the harem candidate. I hope it will still be the same in the future.

This work doesn't have a single outstanding quality so far, and bit by bit logical loopholes appear. It was an acceptable read to waste time in the beginning, but not anymore.

Protagonist isn't dumb and doesn't have a repulsive character.

Cultivation system is one of the common ones, but has a few original twists.

... more>> No typical "arrogant young masters" with family->clan->sect->kingdom->planet revenge chains.

No info dumps, as the world is explored through the perspective of the protagonist.

Plot is fine, but not too intriguing and is unfolding very slowly.

The reason I stopped reading is because there's a huge idiotic mistake in the plot that drives me insane. <<less
